title: avenula arundana
intro: Avenula arundana, commonly known as False Oat-grass, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the grass family. This plant is used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Avenula arundana include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
